_about: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for Cloudflare's Content-Syndication business definitions (campaign-ID filters, client-defined KR/RIG segments, geographic region map, market chips, lead-status buckets). BOTH sides read this file: (1) the CLIENT side loads the ID lists into client_cloudflare.seed_* tables (definitions_seed.py) which sql/10 + sql/14 read live; (2) the VERIFIER side (status_dashboard/job/main.py) builds its Snowflake check SQL from this same file. Editing here (via the platform Data Accuracy tab → 'Make this live') changes BOTH at once, no two-place edit. The repo copy is the version-controlled SEED; the LIVE copy lives at gs://bidbrain-analytics-status-dash/definitions/cloudflare.json.
_maintenance: Churny lists (campaign IDs, segment IDs, assets, buckets, market chips) are seed-driven end-to-end. The geographic country lists are also mirrored as literals inside sql/10's CASE (low-churn structural logic) — if you change geographic_regions here, also update the matching CASE arms in sql/10. Display-label CASEs (PUBLISHER/OFFER_TYPE/PUBLISHER_OFFER) stay as view literals and are out of scope.
last_edited_by: 2026-09-05: added cs_emea_campaigns - the explicit EMEA campaign-ID allowlist (5 IDs, one per publisher) that sql/16 now places FIRST, before the name vote; every EMEA lead was already placed by CAMPAIGN_ID, so this is the same result made explicit, and the export job WARNs by name on any EMEA lead resolved without it (Charles). 2026-09-04: added the Q3 VRSM Lead Magnet campaign (701RG00001W1FQRYA3) to segments.KR so its Korean leads count in the KR chip instead of the OTHER residual - closes the 1,650 vs 1,661 headline-vs-Pacing-detail gap the client reported (Charles). 2026-08-05: added cs_q2_only_campaigns - the 4 P* ABM/Modernize Q2 campaigns still receive REPLACEMENT leads with Q3 created dates; their leads now count only when created before 2026-07-01 so replacements stop surfacing on the Q3 side (client request via Transmission). Both sides (sql/10 + the status verifier) apply the same cap (Ian).

cs_emea_campaigns._note: 2026-09-05 (client rule: EMEA data must never appear in an APAC figure and vice versa; scope by campaign ID, not by name prefix). The Core DG EMEA campaign IDs read by sql/16_stg_cs_leads_v2 (seed_cs_emea_campaign_ids) as the FIRST theatre rule - a lead on one of these IDs is EMEA whatever its campaign NAME says. It matters because the feed is not consistently prefixed: Acquisition's ID 701RG00001e1aegYAA carries 25 'EMEA-<region>' names AND 2 bare-token names (2026_Q3_CEERI_ACQUISITION_... 52 rows, 2026_Q3_DACH_ACQUISITION_... 12 rows) that a LIKE 'EMEA-%' filter would drop into APAC. One Salesforce campaign ID per publisher; every EMEA sub-region (UKI/DACH/SEUR/NEUR/CEERI/MEA) is a NAME under the same ID, so a new region needs no edit here - a new PUBLISHER does. A campaign this list does not hold still resolves by the existing ID vote / name token (never dropped, never defaulted to APAC), and the export job prints a WARNING naming it so it gets added here. NOT read by sql/10 or the status verifier: the legacy APAC model keeps its own 13-ID cs_campaigns list.

campaigns.label: Acquisition - EMEA Core DG (streams 2&3; incl. the two un-prefixed CEERI/DACH VER-FINANCE names)
Final Funnel - EMEA Core DG (IDE Lite)

cs_q2_only_campaigns._note: 2026-08-05 (client request via Transmission): these 4 Q2 campaigns still receive REPLACEMENT leads for rejected Q2 leads, and the replacements carry Q3 created dates (DAY) - so they were surfacing on the Q3 side of the dashboard (the quarter is a created-date range). A lead in one of these campaigns counts ONLY when DAY < cutoff; on/after the cutoff it is excluded EVERYWHERE (Q3 view, QoQ, pacing, the verifier). The ids STAY in cs_campaigns so their Q2 history is untouched. The cutoff date is mirrored as a literal in sql/10 (low-churn structural logic, like the geographic CASE arms) - change both together; the verifier reads it from here.

segments._note: Evaluated BEFORE the geographic_regions buckets: RIG first, then KR. RIG = the Modernize-Applications gaming asset on the 3 Final Funnel campaigns, non-Korea (~172, asset-based so it spans countries). KR = Korea leads in the Core DG CS campaigns: the 6 ORIGINAL El* campaigns (3 Roverpath + 3 Final Funnel Lead-Gen; 2026-07-02, reverting the 2026-06-25 'all Korea in the 12 campaigns' rule at the client's request) + the Q3 VRSM Lead Magnet campaign (2026-09-04). Korea leads from the N*/P* campaigns (Connectivity Cloud / Modernize Security / Modernize Applications) fall through to the OTHER residual (see status_buckets._note).

KR._note: Korea leads AND one of the Core DG CS campaigns: the 6 original El* campaigns (3 Roverpath + 3 Final Funnel Lead-Gen, client request 2026-07-02) PLUS the Q3 VRSM Lead Magnet campaign 701RG00001W1FQRYA3 (added 2026-09-04 - it joined cs_campaigns on 2026-07-10, AFTER the 07-02 decision, and was never added here, so its 10 accepted Korean leads fell to OTHER and were dropped from the headline while the Pacing detail section counted them under Korea: the client-reported 1,650 vs 1,661). Korea leads on the N*/P* campaigns still land in OTHER (not a market chip).

geographic_regions._note: Evaluated AFTER RIG/KR. COUNTRY_NAME → market map at the 2026 media-plan grain (2026-06-25 split: ANZ→AU/NZ, ASEAN→SIM/ROA, GCR→GCR-CN/TW/HK). Case-insensitive — sql/10 AND the status verifier apply UPPER(TRIM(COUNTRY_NAME)). Also mirrored as literals in sql/10's CASE.

status_buckets._note: Cloudflare's CS map (OPPOSITE of mongodb): Accepted = Accepted + Replied + Unresponsive. Since 2026-07-02 a residual 'OTHER' bucket can be non-empty again (it holds Korea leads outside the KR campaigns — see segments.KR). OTHER is NOT one of the 11 market_chips, so those leads are excluded from the dashboard (its totals sum over the chips), matching pre-2026-06-25 behaviour. The status verifier's residual check reports the OTHER count instead of asserting it is 0.
